name: Kotone no Shuki Shuki Polynesian Sex
original_name: ことねのしゅきしゅきポリネシアンセックス
source:
“No producer for the next week!”
Worried about the producer’s exhaustion, Kotone decides to give him a break!
“You were working on your computer, weren’t you?”
But even during his break, the producer continues his producing activities.
“Well, the producer is a bit of a workaholic…”
Kotone puts her plan into action to distract the producer from work.
“Producer, have you heard of Polynesian sex?”
It’s the ultimate sweet and intimate sex that takes place over five days.
“With this, the producer will be horny for five days straight, won’t he?”
“Then I don’t think he’ll be able to concentrate on work.”
“This is my plan to make the producer think of nothing but me!”
A vacation filled with Kotone’s ‘love’ begins now!
